Chapter 1083: Chapter 19 Advancement in Strength (Please Subscribe)_2

Due to the World Tree’s might, it simply cannot envelop such an expansive Internal Universe.

When Lin Yuan first explored the Chaos Void, he held the aspiration of cultivating the World Tree into a Chaos Tree. However, after numerous attempts, he discovered its usefulness was limited.

“Still, being able to obtain a Chaos Tree is no small fortune.”

The red-clad girl praised with a hint of admiration.

She wasn’t captivated by how precious the Chaos Tree is, but rather by how fitting it was for a cultivator like Lin Yuan, who possessed an Internal Universe of extraordinary depth and foundation.

The Chaos Tree’s effects vary greatly depending on the cultivator wielding it.

For an average Chaos Venerable, it might merely stabilize the Internal Universe slightly and shorten the time needed to reach the peak of the Chaos Realm.

Its contribution to combat strength would be minimal.

But in Lin Yuan’s hands? The effects were frightening. At least, judging by the current results, Lin Yuan’s overall combat strength had improved immensely compared to before obtaining the Chaos Tree.

And this was just the beginning. As time passed, the Chaos Tree’s blessings would only grow stronger, supporting him into reaching the Dominator Realm… and even the Chaos Realm.

“It seems fortune smiles upon me.”

A faint smile surfaced on Lin Yuan’s face. He hadn’t anticipated that sending an avatar into the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain would yield such remarkable fortune.

…

After observing the Chaos Tree for a while longer to ensure its roots had taken hold without any issues, Lin Yuan turned his attention to the Transmission Space.

This specific Transmission Space was established by the Tuolong Great Saint, meant explicitly for cultivating a successor.

While the Chaos Tree was indeed its most prized treasure, it was by no means the only one—an abundance of other artifacts had been left behind as well.

Including the Tuolong Great Saint’s legacy.

In truth, the most invaluable aspect of the entire Transmission Space wasn’t the Chaos Tree but rather the soul fragment of the Tuolong Great Saint.

For the vast majority of cultivators, the Chaos Tree’s effects would, at best, stabilize their Internal Universe, granting them an advantage in battles against competitors of the same tier.

But the Tuolong Great Saint’s soul fragment?

That was the key to breaking through bottlenecks and advancing further along the Path of Cultivation.

Guidance from a Great Saint could yield limited usefulness for a Dominator advancing to a Great Saint, but it could have considerable value for someone progressing from Path Pioneer to Dominator, or from Dominator to Venerable.

Even for a Chaos Venerable, the guidance of a Great Saint’s soul fragment—while perhaps not empowering them to ascend into the Great Saint’s Domain—would undoubtedly offer clarity in plotting the path forward.

But Lin Yuan was distinctly different.

The so-called guidance of a Great Saint’s soul fragment held little value for him.

The path Lin Yuan had chosen was rooted in rules and Daos of differing dimensions and frameworks—domains that even Great Saints rarely understood deeply.

Additionally, a Great Saint’s soul fragment would only offer guidance to their chosen successor, and it was evident that Lin Yuan wasn’t suited for the Tuolong Great Saint’s path.

…

Having refined the mysterious Transmission Space, it now measured no larger than the size of a palm, hovering and floating before Lin Yuan.

“Let’s see…”

Lin Yuan immediately began examining it. At this moment, he was the master of this space, fully in command.

“”Nine Tribulations Tuolong Body”?”

Lin Yuan studied this legacy meticulously.

Comparable to the “Xuanhuang Physique” and the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body,” this was a specialized body-refinement technique.

The Tuolong Great Saint was a unique spectacle of life born from the Chaos Void—a ‘Tuolong’ with a physical body of immense strength, unparalleled even after ascending to the Great Saint’s Domain.

It was through this fearsome physical prowess—and other techniques—that the Tuolong Great Saint became a nightmare for other Great Saints of his tier.

The “Nine Tribulations Tuolong Body,” in essence, utilized specialized methods of body refinement to transform one’s corporal form into something resembling the ‘Tuolong’ unique lifeform.

The process required enduring nine tribulations. After overcoming them all, the technique would be considered complete, at which point the cultivator’s body would transform into a new spectacle of life: a ‘Tuolong.’

Thus far, within the boundless Chaos Void, only a single ‘Tuolong’ had ever been birthed.

As such, the Tuolong Great Saint lived a life of solitude, lacking any kin or tribe. The creation of this legacy was infused with the intention to ensure the survival of the ‘Tuolong’ lineage, even as he pursued elevation to the thirteenth tier.

To fully cultivate this body-refinement technique meant to become the next spectacle of life: a ‘Tuolong.’

“There are indeed many merits to it.”

Lin Yuan carefully combed through and examined the contents, his expression contemplative.

In terms of levels, this body-refinement technique was slightly inferior to the “Xuanhuang Physique” and “Demonic Jade Immortal Body.” After all, even at its complete culmination, it would only allow a cultivator’s body to become as powerful as a ‘Tuolong’s.’

By contrast, the “Xuanhuang Physique” and “Demonic Jade Immortal Body”—when cultivated to their peak—made the physical body alone capable of contending against a Chaos Great Saint.

Yet, as a Great Saint-tier body-refinement technique, its intricate details inspired Lin Yuan’s admiration, and he even found ways to incorporate some aspects of it into his body’s refinement, bringing it closer to perfection.

“Tuolong…”

In his mind, Lin Yuan conjured the detailed physical structure of the unique lifeform ‘Tuolong.’ The ultimate goal of the “Nine Tribulations Tuolong Body” was transformation into a Tuolong and naturally required such detailed information about this lifeform.

“The Chaos Void births unique lifeforms, while the Cosmic Starry Skies give rise to extraordinary entities… Both are Innately born, both possess immensely powerful bloodline talents…”

Lin Yuan’s expression took on a thoughtful look, pondering the profound similarities between the Cosmic Starry Skies and the Chaos Void in many respects.

…

Within the Transmission Space, beyond the “Nine Tribulations Tuolong Body,” there were countless other legacies as well.

Lin Yuan meticulously browsed through and absorbed them, integrating portions that benefited his path of cultivation into his own methodology.

Rustle, rustle.

The adaptations to Lin Yuan’s physical body were slow and gradual. Even for someone like His Majesty Xuanhuang, a peerless Great Saint, capturing a Great Saint-level unique lifeform specialized in physicality for research was a near-impossible task.

After all, even at the same level, while His Majesty Xuanhuang, as a supreme Great Saint, was stronger than a typical Chaos Great Saint, capturing one alive? That was akin to scaling the heavens.
